parts.name: Leg (Right Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of acetate plastic, which is lightweight and flexible.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the glasses on the wearer’s ear and helps maintain balance and fit.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold inward for storage or open outward for wearing.

parts.name: Leg (Left Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of acetate plastic, similar to the right leg.
parts.Functional_description: It provides lateral support and stability, resting on the left ear to hold the glasses in place.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold inward or open outward for use.

parts.name: Base Body (Frame Front)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main frame front of the eyeglasses, made of acetate plastic, holding the lenses and connecting both legs.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the lenses and rests on the nose bridge, providing the main structural integrity of the eyeglasses.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary, serving as the central fixed part to which the legs are hinged.
